CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.trg_lab_lot_biological_only()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.produto_id
                    AND NEW.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.microrganismo_id THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  PERFORM platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturable(NEW.produto_id,NEW.microrganismo_id);
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.proximo_codigo(_prefixo text, _tabela text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_codigo_global_generator_closed' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
END;
$function$
